Important: 

Section 6 is *NOT* subject to a Section 33/notwithstanding clause challenge. That means freedom of interprovincial movement is recognized as being SO fundamental to our rights as Canadians, it can not be revoked for even the gravest of circumstance.

Like a pandemic.

“residence & work isnt travel!” — Sure, then walk me through logistics for enforcement & dispute on your ban. Police officers, the ones you want to defund over brutality & discrimination, are going to have unilateral power to -on the spot- adjudicate a citizen invoking Section 6?

How can an officer know who is truthful in their stated intent to *pursue* work a province over? (pursue does not mean “must have already successfully obtained employment” — meaning, it is arguably a constitutional violation for “paperwork showing employment” to be a requirement)

In practice, an interprovincial travel ban will shift fundamental Charter Rights to a framework of assumed guilt until proven innocent. We are not talking about lowly bylaw offences here, this is Charter Rights explicitly & intentionally barred from being touched by Section 33.

No functioning democracy can disregard the Charter like it’s a mayor telling you he’s nabbing $100 if you loiter on a park bench. Where is the expedient process to seek recourse for persons whose Charter Rights are wrongly violated, in a court system already backed up 2+ years?

Theres never even been a successful Section 33 challenge at the Federal level. Are you comfortable as a Canadian citizen, to set a precedent that the most fundamental of our Charter Rights could be decided as optional not by Supreme Court of Canada, but politicians & journalists?

Respect for experts means trust Medical professionals on health, & Supreme Court Justices on Charter Rights. I don’t see a way forward on any enforceable interprovincial travel ban that doesn’t burn up a Charter Right made clear w/ its Section 33 exemption— it is not ours to burn

This is a legal dilemma that should be decided by the Supreme Court of Canada where it belongs. We must trust & consult Doctors, health professionals, scientists & medical researchers about COVID-19. Not uninformed bloggers or pundits. The same applies to Section 6 & the @SCC_eng
